 INVINCIBLE Sets Season 5 Release Date with New Burger Mart Trailer
 by Michael Walsh 
 Nov 19 2026 • 9:00 AM 
 Add us on 
 Quick Take 
 Invincible returns with its newest Burger Mart teaser trailer to announce fans can feast on the animated show’s fifth season in February.
 Invincible season five will debut at Prime Video on February 17, 2027
 Nerdist Take: Some viewers thought Invincible wouldn’t do a Burger Mart trailer this year, but fortunately they were wrong. We’re so glad to have another one of these for our collection.
 You know a TV show is good at serving up amazing teasers when people are preemptively furious they might not get one. That’s what’s been going on ahead of Invincible season five. Viewers have been waiting for the animated superhero show to release its latest Burger Mart trailer . As the show’s return draws nearer, a few fans have become convinced Prime Video isn’t planning on doing them anymore. Those people were, fortunately, very wrong. The streamer headed back to Burger Mart for a tasty and hilarious trailer that also announced Invincible season five’s February release date.
 When Will Invincible Season 5 Release? 
 Invincible season five officially has a February 17, 2027 release date. We know this thanks to Steven Yeun’s titular character stopping by his favorite burger spot. This time he’s joined by Clancy Brown’s demon, Damien Darkblood. It’s not exactly the best meal Invincible has ever had, but it’s not his worst either. No matter how frustrating your dining companion might be, it’s tough to be too angry when your new super suit gets a nice compliment.

 INVINCIBLE Already Renewed for Season 6 Invincible Season 5 Synopsis 
 As for what awaits us in February when Invincible season five is finally released, here’s season five’s official synopsis from Prime Video and Skybound Entertainment:
 Still reeling from his role in the Earth-shattering events of last season, in Season Five, Mark searches for a way to make the world better, even if that means risking everything – including the relationships, friends, and allies he holds dear. Mark’s forced to decide what kind of hero he is and what he’s willing to do to save his planet’s future – and if the ends always justify the means when millions of lives hang in the balance. 
 Prime Video Invincible also stars Sandra Oh and J.K. Simmons. The cast also features Jonathan Banks, Eric Bauza, Christian Convery, Grey DeLisle, Zoey Deutch, Chris Diamantopoulos, Walton Goggins, Danai Gurira, Mark Hamill, Gillian Jacobs, Jason Mantzoukas, Ross Marquand, Tatiana Maslany, Lee Pace, Aaron Paul, Khary Payton, Jay Pharoah, Jack Quaid, Kevin Michael Richardson, Seth Rogen, Matthew Rhys, and Ben Schwartz. 
 RELATED ARTICLE
 INVINCIBLE Season 4 Finale Exclusive Clip: Allen Adjusts to Becoming Leader of the Coalition Nerdist Take: We Are So Excited to Have a New Burger Mart Teaser Trailer 
 Not a bad cast. And, since we’re cooking up some understatement, not a bad Burger Mart teaser trailer, either. They really are the best. We don’t blame anyone for being mad at the thought Invincible might stop serving them to us. But we’re glad Invincible season five’s release date announcement confirmed it wasn’t so. 
 Mikey Walsh is a staff writer at Nerdist. You can follow Mikey on Bluesky at @‌burgermike . (No relation to the restaurant from the teaser. He thinks.)
